question: When replying to or forwarding an email, what should you check before sending to ensure accuracy?
solution:
The correct answer is **__The email subject line__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__.**

 
• When you **receive a message**, there are several actions you can take on that message.

 
 
• To **reply **to only the sender, select **Reply**.
 
• To **reply **to the original sender and all other recipients on the **To and Cc lines**, select Reply All.
